title: Writing Quotation Follow-Up Emails to Prospective Buyers
description: Foundational sales English module covering writing quotation follow-up emails to prospective buyers.
learning_objectives: Master professional Present Perfect with just & already in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in writing quotation follow-up emails to prospective buyers
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: Last week at the defense trade fair, our sales manager _____ the revised quotation for twenty 8x8 chassis to the Egyptian ministry.

explanations.correct: Completed past time reference 'Last week' strictly requires Past Simple 'sent'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect 'has sent' cannot accompany closed past date 'Last week'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Continuous describes current actions, not last week's events.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses past tense for both, but English 'Last week' strictly triggers Past Simple ('sent').
